sources.title: 2020 California county Gazetteer
sources.rights: Underlying U.S. Census Bureau data are public-use federal geographic data; retain agency and file attribution.

processing: Retain California residence counties and California workplace destinations.
Normalize retained worker counts within each residence county.
Project Gazetteer representative points from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:3310.
Form the weighted second moment of workplace-minus-residence displacement vectors.
Add epsilon times the identity, where epsilon is 1e-4 times the median raw tensor trace.
